design.affected_system: municipal capital planning, debt, grants, reserves, procurement, and asset delivery
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform
pair matched project cohort event-study with scope-change controls with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Budgets, obligations, appropriations, encumbrances, expenditures, schedules, and assets are reconciled.
All fiscal scenarios separate nominal, real, committed, contingent, and modeled amounts.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform.

constraints.description: The capital portfolio and municipal finance evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: chief financial officer and capital planning director
design.decision_question: Did phased procurement, bundling, funding, or delivery reforms improve verified cost and schedule performance?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The capital portfolio and municipal finance evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched project cohort event-study with scope-change controls
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in scope-adjusted cost and delivery variance

design.intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in scope-adjusted cost and delivery variance
distributional gap in change in scope-adjusted cost and delivery variance
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal public value, quality, or fiscal health from cost and schedule variance alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased municipal capital delivery and financing reform passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

design.title: Evaluate capital delivery and financing reforms
transportability_risks: Accounting, tax authority, debt limits, grants, procurement, labor, and markets differ.
Historical delivery and cost relationships may shift under inflation or policy change.

family.affected_system: municipal capital planning, debt, grants, reserves, procurement, and asset delivery
claim_boundary: Requests and proxy indicators do not replace engineering inspection, accounting, or legal review.
Selected projects and schedules are planning outputs, not appropriations, designs, contracts, or construction.
Modeled lifecycle, emissions, reliability, and fiscal effects are not realized outcomes.
family.decision_owner: chief financial officer and capital planning director
family.description: Eight decisions for obligation diagnosis, fiscal forecasting, portfolio selection, reserve siting, funding allocation, delivery scheduling, fiscal stress, and financing evaluation.
family.title: Capital portfolio and municipal finance

library_claim_boundary: The catalog contains 240 decision designs, not 240 city executions.
Exactly twelve designs map to existing Tier-D reference templates; 228 remain design-only.
A reference implementation can be an explicit negative release and does not imply impact.
No record claims a city binding, new method, deployment, adoption, or real-user outcome.
Future execution requires source binding, gate passage, and domain, legal, community, and operational review.
